ambiguity.rule: If IT is not FreeTextCallout and CL is absent, annotation is a textbox
If IT is FreeTextCallout or CL callout coordinates are present, annotation is a callout
Text annotation with standard Note/Comment icon; sticky notes represent standalone canvas notes
Root Text annotation with reply and/or Review state children linked through IRT is a comment; root-level StateModel remains a legacy-read compatibility signal
Unambiguous standard PDF subtype Highlight with QuadPoints coordinate arrays
Unambiguous standard PDF subtype Underline with QuadPoints coordinate arrays
Unambiguous standard PDF subtype StrikeOut with QuadPoints coordinate arrays
Unambiguous standard PDF subtype Squiggly with QuadPoints coordinate arrays
Square annotation lacking BE cloud border effect and non-mask coloring is shape-rect
Unambiguous standard PDF subtype Polygon with Vertices coordinate list

Line annotation with OpenArrow or ClosedArrow in LE is an arrow

Text.primary_distinction: Review reply/state IRT topology vs standalone sticky note; root-level StateModel is accepted only for legacy compatibility
Text.oracle_rule: If the Text root participates in review reply/state IRT topology, classify as comment; otherwise classify as sticky-note unless legacy StateModel/custom metadata proves comment semantics

Square.primary_distinction: BE (Border Effect) for cloud, solid black fill/stroke mask for redaction, standard stroke/fill for shape-rect
Square.oracle_rule: If BE is present with /S /C -> shape-cloud; else if visual mask styling -> redaction; else shape-rect

Line.oracle_rule: If LE contains OpenArrow or ClosedArrow -> arrow; else line

FreeText.primary_distinction: IT dictionary entry (/FreeTextCallout) and CL callout line coordinates
FreeText.oracle_rule: If IT is FreeTextCallout or CL is defined -> callout; else textbox

appearance_stream_requirement.rationale: External viewers without dynamic appearance generation (Adobe Acrobat, Preview, third-party viewers) depend on explicit /AP streams to render annotations.

external_edit_precedence.rationale: Recognized standard PDF state is authoritative on re-import. DA and QuadPoints are now represented by the production reader/writer rather than remaining implied or pending support.

field_mappings.DA: FreeText DA overrides cached fontSize/textColor. Exact source DA is reused on a no-op; supported local font-size/color edits rewrite those operators while preserving the external font resource token.
field_mappings.QuadPoints: Text-markup QuadPoints override cached geometry and are projected as Rect-normalized textMarkupQuads. Exact source QuadPoints are reused on a no-op; local Rect move/resize regenerates scaled PDF-space quads.
field_mappings.F: Import the standard Locked flag bit into data.locked; on rewrite toggle only that bit and preserve all other external annotation flag bits.
field_mappings.Border: Import border width plus solid/dashed/dotted/none style; reuse the source Border object on a semantic no-op and regenerate only after a supported local border edit.
field_mappings.Q: FreeText quadding 0/1/2 maps to left/center/right textAlign and overrides stale private data.
field_mappings.Open: Text annotation Open maps inversely to data.isCollapsed for both review comments and standalone sticky notes; externally supplied Name/icon is preserved independently.
field_mappings.Name: Stamp Name maps recognized standard stamp names to stampStyle and preserves unknown external names while style remains custom; Text annotation icon names are preserved on rewrite.
field_mappings.LE: Line endings map supported standard endings to lineStartCap/lineEndCap; source LE is reused on no-op so unrepresented standard ending names are not normalized away.
field_mappings.IT: FreeTextCallout participates in standards-native textbox/callout classification; unrecognized external intent values are preserved when the annotation remains a textbox.
field_mappings.BE: Cloud border effect participates in standards-native Square classification; the source cloud BE dictionary, including intensity, is preserved on no-op.
field_mappings.BS: When present, BS is authoritative over Border. Supported W/S/D semantics map to borderWidth/borderStyle; exact source BS is reused on no-op. Supported local border edits regenerate/remove BS so a stale external style dictionary cannot override the edit. Unsupported BS styles are preserved while no supported local style replacement is requested.

external_edit_precedence.type_precedence_rule: For standard-resolvable subtype ambiguities (FreeText, Square, Line), recognized standard fields override stale PDFHubType. Text comment-vs-sticky may retain valid private type only where native reply/state topology does not resolve the application distinction.

save_vs_export_separation.rationale: Save/Save As must remain fully editable without destroying native /Annot dictionaries. Export Flattened permanently renders into page contents.

signed_pdf_rewrite_policy.rationale: Full document rewrite invalidates cryptographic signatures. Users must be warned explicitly.

review_state_projection.projection_rule: Project the latest observable Review transition by modification/creation timestamp with annotation order as a deterministic fallback.
review_state_projection.preservation_rule: Preserve all native Review state transition annotations and their existing IRT topology. New PDF Hub Review state transitions refer directly to the original review annotation and are appended only when the application review status differs semantically from the latest native Review state.
review_state_projection.limitation: Parallel author-specific Review states are preserved in the PDF but are not yet surfaced as separate application statuses.

transition_author.write_rule: New Review state transitions use statusAuthor when known; thread author is only a fallback for legacy/imported metadata lacking transition-actor provenance.
transition_author.chain_rule: New Review state transitions refer directly to the original review annotation regardless of author. Existing imported state-to-state chains are preserved as legacy topology.

reply_thread_topology.preservation_rule: Preserve direct and nested RT=R reply ancestry through ReviewReply.parentReplyId. Rewritten native replies reconstruct IRT to the logical parent reply; missing or cyclic parent IDs fail safe to the review root.
reply_thread_topology.reply_state_rule: Preserve and relink state annotations attached to replies, but never project those reply-attached states onto the root review status.
reply_thread_topology.unparsed_reply_rule: RT=R descendants that cannot be represented as ReviewReply, for example a reply with no parseable Contents, remain native and are not deleted. Their IRT is relinked when a managed root or represented parent reply is rewritten.

native_dictionary_preservation.ownership_rule: PDF Hub rewrites only fields it semantically owns for the supported annotation model. Other standard, vendor, and extension dictionary entries are copied forward.
native_dictionary_preservation.reply_passive_rule: Reply fields outside PDF Hub's reply identity/content/thread ownership, including externally supplied Rect/style/extension metadata, are copied forward when the logical reply is rewritten.
native_dictionary_preservation.appearance_rule: An existing AP entry is preserved only when every PDF Hub-owned appearance-driving field is semantically unchanged. If a local edit changes those fields, stale AP is omitted rather than allowed to override the edited native state.
native_dictionary_preservation.state_rule: Native Review state annotations are preserved in place and only their IRT target is relinked when a managed root/reply reference changes.

standard_field_coverage.source: Union of fixtures[*].standardPdfFields plus review-graph supplemental fields
standard_field_coverage.rule: Every declared standard field must be covered by at least one explicit category. Unclassified declared fields fail the Phase 10 audit.

state.transition_rule: New Review state annotations refer directly to the original review annotation through IRT. Legacy/imported state-to-state chains are accepted and preserved without destructive normalization.

external_nested_reply.identity_rule: Nested reply logical identity is stable across private-metadata loss and repeated PDF Hub saves.
external_nested_reply.state_on_reply_rule: A Review state whose IRT targets a reply is preserved and relinked to that reply when replies are rewritten, but it does not update the root thread status.
external_nested_reply.opaque_descendant: An external RT=R reply lacking Contents remains native across repeated PDF Hub saves with passive metadata and repaired IRT.
